_comment: Tow-first merge policy (Ron, 2026-08-24). GM stock read is the authority; verified hardware facts are pinned; #24's WOT shift rescale (verified for 4.11/35s) is kept. Community tow consensus (see data/refs/tow_consensus_2010_silverado.md) maps onto this platform as: keep GM's own Pattern A (Tow/Haul) TCC/shift tables stock, keep torque management/abuse mode ENABLED, keep the low-octane spark table conservative — i.e. stock-source wins those areas by design. No 'tow' reference cal exists because the community gives strategies and ranges, not cell values; fabricating tables is forbidden. Line-pressure max tables are inert clamps on a stock 6L80 (hjtrbo, HPT forum) — never rule-route them.

rules.note: #24's WOT shift speeds are the verified 4.11+35s rescale; raw stock MPH cells assume 3.08/2475mm
